title: Fuzz / property tests: decode(encode(x)) == x for all x
description:
Add property-based round-trip tests and edge-case corpus.

1. Round-trip property: for any Vec<u8> input, decode(encode(input, 'test', 644)) == input. Use proptest or a hand-rolled exhaustive sweep over short inputs (0..256 bytes, all byte values).

2. Fuzz corpus in tests/fuzz_corpus/: a set of hand-crafted &[u8] inputs that must not panic, covering:
   - Empty input
   - Input with no begin line
   - Truncated begin line (e.g. b'begin')
   - begin line with no filename
   - begin-base64 block
   - Data line with byte 0x00 (outside UU range)
   - Data line with byte 0x7F
   - Data line with byte 0xFF
   - Line claiming 45 bytes but only 1 encoded char present
   - 10,000-byte all-zeros input (size stress)
   - Input that is valid UU but with CRLF endings throughout

3. For each fuzz corpus item: assert no panic, assert result is Ok or a recognized UuError variant. Do not assert specific decoded content for malformed inputs.

4. No external fuzzing framework required -- a #[test] that iterates the corpus is sufficient. If proptest is available in the workspace, use it; if not, do not add it as a dependency.
